notes.title: Tiny Man's Revenge Remastered
notes.notes:
"Tiny Man's Revenge" has been upgraded to "Tiny Man's Revenge Remastered," boasting a meticulously structured experience compared to its predecessor. This update not only introduces additional stages and numerous tutorial maps but also paves the way for further expansion in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360775/47f8188f21a952af9e6bd7d87c5a38e888054a7e.png[/img]

notes.title: Cheat Codes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Cheat Codes that can be activated in the game. Works as follows;
Each action resets after 3 seconds of inactivity. 
ShrinkAndSteal = T
Jump = M
Sprint = R

Cheat codes 
[list]
[*] TTMMRM
[*] MMMRM
[*] TMTMTM
[*] TTTTMMM
[*] TTTTTTM
[/list]
Try them and see what happens. Cheat codes can be applied more than once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360775/790435083651cc3d85d3a2143fe54dad140ddcd2.png[/img]

You can see what icon to press to pick up items now & the training map has been moved high in the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360775/d9a0697ec10c887f9ad179835d4c1ba3a9eab5ee.png[/img]
